_comment: Row map for the Accel-KKR CFO Chronograph template (assets/chronograph_template.xlsx). Every labelled row of the sheet is listed here as '<Section> | <Label>' and says where its monthly values come from. Sources: pl / bs / cf = the Finance view lines (a name is read at the deepest COA or cash-flow level it exists), arr / customers = ARR_ANALYTICS bridge categories (arr month-to-date, customers LTM counts), bookings / pipeline = GTM_ANALYTICS metrics, revolver = one METRIC of Finance's manual REVOLVER table in FINANCE_ANALYTICS (never added across METRIC), revolver_drawn = the balance sheet month-end balance of the revolver account (config/scope.json revolver_drawn_account), arr_rate = a ratio of two ARR_ANALYTICS LTM amounts (derived, labelled), customer_rate = a ratio of ARR_ANALYTICS LTM customer counts (derived, labelled; blank where the denominator is missing or 0), 'level' pins a line to one COA level and a list of lines takes them all, 'negate' writes the row with the view's sign reversed, because the template enters costs, outflows, churn, downsell and lost customers as positive amounts and subtracts them in its formulas (the build's calculations and gates use the view's sign), 'blank_if_all_zero' leaves a metric blank when the view returns 0 in every month, null = no view carries it (the row is left blank, never 0). 'remainder_of' fills a group's Other row with the line total less the rows named. 'formula' rows keep the template's own formula, copied to every month. 'chain' rows take the first month from the source and keep the template's link to the prior month after it. The build refuses any labelled row that is not listed, and any template whose hash differs from template_sha256.

display._comment: Amounts are held in USD thousands: the build divides every amount it writes by 1,000 and the formulas calculate in thousands; the gates multiply back and compare in dollars. Counts (Customer Bridge, Headcount), percentages and ratios are not divided.

cf_unlabelled_comment: Strict cash-flow mapping: every cash-flow row is filled only from rows the view labels (CASH_FLOW_L1..L3). Rows the view leaves without a cash-flow label are placed in no line; they are reported (confirm_at_source) with their monthly amounts. The view's own Net Cash Flow and Ending Cash include them, so the sheet reads those totals from the view's labels and reports the gap to Cash before Financing + Cash from Financing.

Profit & Loss | Depreciation & Amortizat.explain: D&A is entered positive as a cost in the template; a negative amount means the view books it as income. Today the group-level Amortization adjustment (key -10000) adds about 4.5mn a month to Net Income and is included again in the view's Net Cash Flow as a row without a cash-flow label. Confirm its sign with the view owner
